This folder holds a required compiled library used when showing the
variant exam total. Keep the DLL in source control. Do not add its
source, PDB, or XML documentation to this repository.

File: MosPowerPoint.PracticeScoring.dll
Scoring: first 21 correct answers share 700 points (7x34 + 14x33),
remaining correct answers share 300 points (6x22 + 8x21). Integers only.
